usedFor: Shopify spots abandoned checkouts, and TURKEY SMS texts the shopper through your TURKEY SMS account with “Send SMS”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Send SMS” in TURKEY SMS
bestTemplate.why: A shopper who leaves a checkout gets a text through your TURKEY SMS account.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling and a checkout may hold only an email, so “Send SMS” can lack a number.
